name: star-filled void
description: An endless expanse of blackness, interrupted by tiny points of light.  Are they moving?

name: fractal sand
description: A large area of fine sand, forming whorls and fractal patterns.  The whorls rise in the air and continue over the edge of the chasm, forming a feathered sandy border around the abyss.

name: absent edifice
description: There is nothing here, an absence of what should be shadow or form.  Your eyes tell you to keep going but your body stubbornly refuses to move through this space.
